name: CSAT
summary: The shared thumbs up/down satisfaction prompt — the one CSAT control, not a bespoke rating.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-csat> — the reusable form of the feedback pattern's CSAT rule. A binary thumbs-up/down prompt with a required `source` for typo-proof analytics segmentation; it emits a composed `rate` event, and a thumbs-down opens a free-text feedback popover that emits a composed `feedback` event on submit. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; the thumbs are the shared <aha-icon> BY NAME, the follow-up reuses the shared <aha-popover> + <aha-counted-textarea> + <aha-button>, and the selected/hover states animate on PERSISTENT button nodes (class toggle, no rebuild). Zero drift.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin wrapper that listens for the `rate` and `feedback` events; Vue binds the custom element natively. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Layout
spec.value: borderless single row (21px high): 14px #4A4A4A prompt + 16px thumb icons, no chrome — the only layout (legacy `inline` is a no-op)

spec.label: Thumbs-down
spec.value: registers value='down' + emits `rate`, then opens a feedback popover (shared <aha-popover>, role=dialog · Esc/outside-click close) anchored to the down thumb — a prompt, an <aha-counted-textarea> and a primary Send button; dismissing keeps the down rating

spec.label: Thank-you
spec.value: opt-in `thanks` — check + success #16C49A line fades in (motion tokens): instantly on up, after feedback submit on down

props.name: prompt
props.desc: Optional question shown before the thumbs

props.name: source
props.desc: Stable placement token for analytics — passed in the rate and feedback events

props.name: value
props.desc: The current rating (also reflects a click); syncs the selected thumb's aria-pressed

props.name: thanks
props.desc: Opt-in thank-you line — shown (role=status) after rating (on down, after feedback submit); fades in on a persistent node

props.name: feedback-prompt
props.desc: Heading shown at the top of the thumbs-down feedback popover

props.name: feedback-placeholder
props.desc: Placeholder for the free-text field in the feedback popover

whenToUse.when: a lightweight satisfaction check on a feature or a piece of content
a full-block outcome after an operation
you need structured, multi-field feedback with validation

opinion.note: Use the shared control — never build a bespoke rating. Always pass a stable `source` per placement so segmentation stays typo-proof. Keep it to the binary thumbs; free-text is asked for ONLY after a thumbs-down (the built-in feedback popover), and never block rendering on tracking.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — this is the reusable component form of the feedback pattern's CSAT rule (parts/feedback.guide.md): a binary thumbs widget with a required source token, and the 'ask for free-text only after a thumbs-down' follow-up realised by reusing <aha-popover> + <aha-counted-textarea> + <aha-button>. The dedicated `feedback` event maps to the pattern's distinct CSAT_FEEDBACK_SUBMITTED analytics event (separate from CSAT_RATED). Colours + motion map to the token layer. A deliberate, documented AhaSlides surface.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. The [data-probe] probe is pre-rated (value='up') so the borderless single-row layout — the muted #4A4A4A 400-weight prompt, the borderless 16px thumb icon-button, the selected primary colour and the aria-pressed a11y contract — is measurable; it also pins the thumbs-down feedback flow: the down thumb carries aria-haspopup='dialog' and the shared <aha-popover> is present in the shadow root.
